assumption_ledger.note: Privacy team capacity to complete review within operational timeframe
Security team capacity to complete review within timeframe
Whether vendor sandbox environment is configured to receive redacted replay packages
Audit ticket creation process is documented and available

mitigations: Require dual approval from privacy and security teams and security teams before activating the exception
Create and reference an audit ticket before granting any access
Limit the exception to 24 hours with automatic expiry
Use redacted sandbox-only export instead of direct production tokens
Apply least-privilege scoping to minimize data exposure
primary_risk.statement: Granting vendor access to C3 customer replay traces creates privacy and security exposure if approvals or audit controls are not properly enforced.

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval - the narrowest policy-compliant path that unblocks the vendor need
Sanitized sample bundle only - policy-safe but less useful than P2 for the vendor validation need
Deny without fallback - over-corrects when a narrower policy-compliant path exists
Direct local override token - technically possible but explicitly forbidden by policy as it bypasses required approvals and audit
